items.title: Albert Francis Interview, 1961-08-04
items.q: I played most of the band in town. ... Joe was playing, when Lloyd was playing with us too, Joe had a brass band on there, Joe Oliver. He was playing with Manuel Perez.

ctx.x: You mentioned something about you worked with Buddy Petit, that's when you gave up your other job.
Yeah, first band I played in the cabaret, after I left Joe. Joe was watching them. I was playing the Poodle Dog, or Liberty and Biamma.
